# Guardian weapons

Weapons (kind 31) only the Guardian can equip: maces (hammers) and cannons.

Class page: [[wiki/classes/5-guardian\|Guardian]]. The weapon decides the skills: Q/W/E/R are the weapon's four normal skills (`WeaponBase`).

30 items.
